parameters.name: ApplyId
parameters.description: The application batch ID of the devices that you want to register in batches. The application batch ID is generated by calling the [BatchCheckDeviceNames](~~69482~~) operation.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter has a value, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If this parameter has no value, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the devices that you want to register in batches belong.
